description: The ICUSTAYS table contains information on individual ICU stays for patients within the database. It provides unique identifiers for each stay, the associated patient and hospital admission, the source database, the care units and wards involved, admission and discharge timestamps, and the calculated length of stay in the ICU. This table can be used to analyze ICU utilization, patient flow, and length of stay patterns.

columns.name: ROW_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each row in the dataset.

columns.name: HADM_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each hospital admission.

columns.name: ICUSTAY_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each ICU stay.

columns.name: DBSOURCE
columns.description: The database source the data was extracted from; values include 'carevue', 'metavision' or 'both'.

columns.name: FIRST_CAREUNIT
columns.description: The first care unit the patient was admitted to during the ICU stay. Possible values include CCU, CSRU, MICU, NICU, SICU, and TSICU.

columns.name: LAST_CAREUNIT
columns.description: The last care unit the patient was in during the ICU stay. Possible values include CCU, CSRU, MICU, NICU, SICU, and TSICU.

columns.name: FIRST_WARDID
columns.description: The ward ID of the patient at the start of the ICU stay.

columns.name: LAST_WARDID
columns.description: The ward ID of the patient at the end of the ICU stay.

columns.name: INTIME
columns.description: The timestamp of when the patient was admitted to the ICU.

columns.name: OUTTIME
columns.description: The timestamp of when the patient was discharged from the ICU.

columns.name: LOS
columns.description: The length of stay (LOS) in the ICU, calculated as the difference between OUTTIME and INTIME in days.
